class.name: IfcConic
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A conic ( IfcConic ) is a planar curve which could be produced by intersecting a plane with a cone. A conic is defined in terms of its intrinsic geometric properties rather than being described in terms of other geometry. A conic class always has a placement coordinate system defined by a two or three dimensional placement. The parametric representation is de

members.member: The location and orientation of the conic. Further details of the interpretation of this attribute are given for the individual subtypes."
